name: Liu Kuo
bio: Liu Kuo (劉過; Liu Guo; 1154–1206) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 唐多令 (Tang duo ling)
poems.author: Liu Kuo
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
芦叶满汀洲。
塞沙带浅流。
二十年、重过南楼。
柳下系舟犹未稳，能几日、又中秋。
黄鹤断矶头。
故人今不在。
旧江山，浑是新愁。
欲买桂花同载酒，终不似、少年游。
